name: Alessia Mancini
bio:
Alessia Mancini's journey in motorsport began unconventionally. Initially a data analyst for a major automotive manufacturer, she was drawn to the strategic complexities of racing. A chance opportunity to work on telemetry analysis for a Formula 3 team ignited a passion that led her through the ranks. She quickly established herself as a sharp strategist, capable of making split-second decisions under immense pressure.

Her calm demeanor belies a relentless drive for success. Alessia emphasizes a data-driven approach combined with empowering her team. At Hot Car Competições, she’s known for fostering a culture of open communication and calculated risk-taking. While her technical knowledge is strong, she considers her ability to motivate and unite disparate personalities towards a common goal her greatest strength. She wants to bring Hot Car Competições to the top of the podium.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with subtle waves
physical.description: Alessia is a woman of average height with a composed and intelligent presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Prefers to listen to classical music to focus before a race.
Has a lucky espresso cup she uses every race day.
